rationale: Paper 2208.00188 directly addresses the discrepancy by updating constraints on the tensor-to-scalar ratio using data from BICEP/Keck and Planck, contributing substantive new evidence on the tensor-to-scalar ratio but not fully resolving the discrepancy. Other papers are adjacent, focusing on related methodologies or future experiments.
